welcome.tagline: Track your calories and macros with AI. Just snap a photo or describe what you ate.
welcome.feature_3_desc: Weight and macro trends over time

dashboard.ai_description: Type your meal below or take a photo and let AI do the work.
dashboard.no_meals_today: No meals logged today — describe what you ate in the chat above.
dashboard.days_logged: {n} day logged this week | {n} days logged this week
dashboard.no_meals_this_week: No meals logged this week yet.
dashboard.tap_to_edit: Tap any item to edit details.
dashboard.history_modal_desc: Last 7 days. Tap a day, then a meal to see details. Today's meals can be removed.
dashboard.describe_placeholder: e.g. grilled chicken 150g, brown rice 100g, broccoli…
dashboard.type_or_attach_error: Type a description or attach a photo.
dashboard.adjust_goal_desc: Choose how aggressive your calorie target should be.
dashboard.adj_slow_cut_desc: Good for retaining muscle. Sustainable long-term.
dashboard.adj_aggressive_desc: Fast results. Best kept short-term only.
dashboard.adj_very_lean_desc: Minimal fat gain. Slowest muscle growth.
dashboard.adj_classic_bulk_desc: Faster gains. More fat gain accepted.
dashboard.adj_maintain_desc: No surplus or deficit. Maintain current weight.
dashboard.activity_ai_description: Describe your workout or activity and let AI estimate the calories burned.
dashboard.describe_activity_placeholder: e.g. Ran 5km in 30 minutes, 45 min gym session, 1 hour cycling…
dashboard.type_activity_error: Type a description of your activity.
dashboard.activity_analysis_failed: Activity analysis failed. Please try again.
dashboard.ai_review_desc: Review the AI's analysis. Add anything it missed or correct any mistakes.
dashboard.ai_review_add_placeholder: e.g. "also had a glass of milk" or "that's spinach, not broccoli"

fitness.title: Fitness Profile
fitness.desc: Update your stats — your daily calorie goal will be recalculated automatically.
fitness.onboarding_desc: Tell us about yourself so we can set your daily calorie goal.
fitness.target_weight_lose_error: Target weight must be lower than your current weight for a loss goal.
fitness.target_weight_gain_error: Target weight must be higher than your current weight for a gain goal.
fitness.activity_added_daily: Activity calories are added to your goal each day
fitness.goal_note_lose: Includes a 500 kcal/day deficit · ~0.5 kg/week loss
fitness.goal_note_gain: Includes a 300 kcal/day surplus · ~0.3 kg/week gain
fitness.goal_note_maintain: No surplus or deficit · maintain current weight
fitness.tdee_explanation: This is your TDEE — the calories your body burns on a sedentary day. Your goal adjustment and logged activities are added on top in the dashboard.

settings.title: Settings
settings.manage_desc: Manage your profile and account settings
settings.profile_info_desc: Update your name and email address
settings.name: Name
settings.resend_verification: Click here to resend the verification email.
settings.verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
settings.update_password_desc: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure
settings.delete_account_desc: Delete your account and all of its resources
settings.delete_caution: Please proceed with caution, this cannot be undone.
settings.delete_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
settings.delete_confirm_desc: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will also be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

tutorial.slide1_body: Your AI-powered nutrition companion. Log meals, track activities, and hit your calorie goals — all in one place.
tutorial.slide2_body: Take a photo or describe what you ate. MacroBot's AI instantly breaks it down into calories, protein, carbs, and fat.
tutorial.slide3_body: Describe your workout and the AI estimates your calories burned. Your daily calorie target adjusts automatically.
tutorial.slide4_body: The ring on your dashboard fills as you eat. Stay in the green to hit your goal — the ring turns red if you go over.
tutorial.slide5_body: Browse AI-generated recipes tailored to your goal. Tap 'I ate this' and MacroBot logs the meal for you instantly.

auth.log_in_desc: Enter your email and password below to log in
auth.register_desc: Enter your details below to create your account
auth.name: Name
auth.forgot_password_desc: Enter your email to receive a password reset link
auth.verify_email_desc: Before continuing, could you verify your email address by clicking on the link we emailed to you? If you didn't receive the email, we will gladly send you another.
auth.verification_link_sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
auth.confirm_password_desc: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.
auth.two_factor_desc: Please confirm access to your account by entering the authentication code provided by your authenticator application.
